item.title: About Us
For Families with a Parent Living Alone
item.description: Your parent lives alone. You want to know they’re okay. Maybe it’s your mom in the house she’s lived in for 30 years. Maybe it’s your dad who insists he doesn’t need help. They value their independence — and you respect that. But you also lie awake sometimes wondering: Did they eat today? Are they moving around? Is today a normal day? AgeWell was designed for exactly this situation. How it works for a single-person household Simple setup.

item.title: For Households with Multiple Elders
item.description: When it’s not just one parent — it’s both. Maybe your parents still live together. Maybe it’s a parent and an elderly aunt, or siblings sharing a home. Multi-person households have a unique challenge: how do you know if each person is doing well when they’re together most of the time? AgeWell is built to handle this. How AgeWell works in a shared home More sensors, smarter patterns. In a multi-person household, we recommend a larger sensor kit with coverage across more rooms.

item.title: For Senior Living & Care Providers
item.description: A better offering for your residents and their families If you run an assisted living facility, senior residence, or home care service, you know that family trust is everything. Families choose you because they believe their loved one will be safe, respected, and well cared for. AgeWell helps you deliver on that promise — with technology that monitors well-being without ever compromising privacy. Why care providers choose AgeWell Differentiate your facility.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: FAQ Find answers to common questions about AgeWell below. Is this a medical device? No. AgeWell is a wellness monitoring system designed to help families stay aware of changes in an aging parent’s daily routine. It is not a medical device, does not provide diagnoses, and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical care. Does it detect falls? AgeWell is not designed as a fall detection system. It monitors patterns of movement and daily routines over time.

item.title: Privacy & Security
item.description: Wellness, not medical AgeWell is a wellness monitoring system, not a medical device. It is designed to help families stay aware of routine changes in an aging parent’s daily patterns. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical advice, or replace professional healthcare. If you have concerns about a loved one’s health, always consult with a qualified healthcare provider. No cameras. No audio. Ever. This is not negotiable. AgeWell will never include cameras, microphones, or any form of audio or video recording.

item.title: Setup: From Kit to Peace of Mind
item.description: How setup works AgeWell is designed to be simple for families and respectful for older adults. You receive a ready-to-use kit, place the monitors in key spots, and confirm everything from your mobile phone. 1. We send you the kit Your starter kit includes the monitors, labels for where to place them, and a quick setup guide. Monitors are small and discreet. No cameras and no microphones. Built for normal homes, no special wiring required.
